- The control looked cramped and not clearly defined

- Buttons have distinct gray backgrounds (`bg-gray-50`)
- Proper borders separating the buttons from the input
- Shadow for depth (`shadow-sm`)
- Icons are larger and darker (`w-4 h-4 text-gray-700`)
- White background on the center input for contrast
- Number input hides the default browser spinner arrows

6. Changed icon color to darker `text-gray-700`
7. Set a fixed width (`w-14`) for the number input
8. Hid browser's default number input spinners

Hey @Manvitha, thanks for the feedback! Here's what I've updated:

**Changes made:**
- ✅ Consolidated Licenses & Add-ons into a single Overview tab with collapsible sections
- ✅ Moved Invoices to a separate tab for cleaner navigation
- ✅ Added sync error state design — click Retry/Sync 1-2 times to see the error messages
- ✅ Simplified non-billable licenses display (just shows count, no type breakdown)
- ✅ Removed the Chargebee footer from error banner as requested

**On the price change confirmation:**
I'd recommend keeping this in two places:
1. **While editing** — so users see the cost difference in real-time
2. **On confirm** — as a final double-check before saving

This gives users visibility at both stages and reduces accidental changes. Happy to discuss if you feel differently!
